children: GMR Solutions entered into an amendment to reprice its first-lien term loan facility. The move refinances the remaining loans into a replacement facility and reduces the SOFR margin to +2.75% from +3.25%. The company also voluntarily prepaid about $200 million, bringing first-lien term loans to approximately $2.7 billion and projecting roughly $28 million in annual cash interest savings. Other terms of the facility remain largely unchanged.
: Amendment to first-lien term loan credit agreement (repricing via replacement facility)
